title: Measuring Bias or Measuring the Task: Understanding the Brittle Nature of LLM Gender Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model pronoun preferences (e.g., 'he', 'she', 'they') using token probabilities and discrete-choice metrics across four task formats (completion, association, multiple-choice, and sentence completion) triggered by descriptions of physical attributes, while systematically manipulating the presence of explicit instructions and gender salience in the prompts.
